title: 預防接種受害救濟申請
steward: 急性傳染病組（預防接種）承辦人
summary: 接種疫苗後疑似發生不良反應且造成損害，本人或法定代理人可向接種所在地的衛生局提出受害救濟申請；由預防接種受害救濟審議小組依醫學專業審議因果關係，決定是否給付及金額。
note: 本頁依疾管署官網「預防接種受害救濟」分類整理，流程、期限與金額尚待急性傳染病組逐項確認
whoCanApply: 接種疫苗後疑似受害的本人
法定代理人（未成年或無行為能力者）
受害人死亡時的法定繼承人
introMarkdown:
依《傳染病防治法》第 30 條與《預防接種受害救濟基金徵收及審議辦法》，因接種疫苗（公費或自費的**國內領有許可證或專案核准**的疫苗）而受害者，可申請救濟。救濟不是賠償，不以證明接種單位有過失為前提，而是由審議小組依醫學專業判斷**損害與接種的關聯性**。

**請留意申請期限**：自知道受害之日起 **2 年內**提出；自受害發生之日起超過 **5 年**就不能再申請（期限以法規現行條文為準）。常見、輕微、可預期的不良反應（例如注射部位紅腫、短暫發燒）不在救濟範圍。

接種後出現不適，請先就醫並保留病歷；接種單位與醫療院所也會依規定通報疑似不良事件。申請救濟與通報是兩件事，通報不等於申請。

## 救濟給付與金額上限

審議小組依「與接種的關聯性」與傷害程度，在下表範圍內審定金額；表列為**上限**，實際金額依個案就醫過程、傷害程度審定。

| 給付種類 | 確定與接種相關 | 無法確定關聯 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 死亡給付 | 最高新臺幣 600 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 350 萬元 |
| 障礙給付：極重度 | 最高新臺幣 600 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 350 萬元 |
| 障礙給付：重度 | 最高新臺幣 500 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 300 萬元 |
| 障礙給付：中度 | 最高新臺幣 400 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 250 萬元 |
| 障礙給付：輕度 | 最高新臺幣 250 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 200 萬元 |
| 嚴重疾病給付 | 最高新臺幣 300 萬元 | 最高新臺幣 120 萬元 |
| 其他不良反應給付 | 最高新臺幣 20 萬元 | 依附表審定 |

另有固定金額的給付：

- **喪葬補助費**：疑因接種死亡並經病理解剖者，新臺幣 30 萬元。
- **孕婦死產或流產**：胎兒孕程滿 20 週新臺幣 10 萬元，未滿 20 週新臺幣 5 萬元。
- **給付競合**：同一案件符合兩種以上給付時，擇金額較高者給付；已領較低金額者補足差額。

障礙等級依身心障礙者權益保障法令認定；嚴重疾病依全民健康保險重大傷病範圍或嚴重藥物不良反應通報規定認定。

> 本表依衛生福利部 2021 年公開說明整理，**尚未與現行辦法附表逐字核對**；申請前請以衛生局與疾管署公告的現行附表為準。
requiredDocuments: 預防接種受害救濟申請書（向衛生局索取或下載）
受害人的病歷摘要、診斷證明或相關醫療紀錄（含就醫日期、診斷與治療經過）
預防接種紀錄（兒童健康手冊、接種證明或接種單位證明）
受害人與申請人的身分證明文件；法定代理人或繼承人另附關係證明
死亡案件：死亡證明書、解剖或鑑定報告（若有）

steps.title: 先就醫並保留證據
steps.text: 接種後出現疑似不良反應先就醫，請醫師詳實記載；保留接種紀錄與所有醫療單據。

steps.title: 向接種所在地衛生局提出申請
steps.text: 填寫申請書並附應備文件，送交接種所在地的縣市衛生局；衛生局會協助補齊資料並調閱接種與就醫紀錄。

steps.title: 衛生局初審並轉送疾管署
steps.text: 衛生局查核文件完整性、蒐集相關病歷後，函送疾管署辦理審議。

steps.title: 審議小組審議
steps.text: 預防接種受害救濟審議小組（醫學、法律、社會公正人士組成）依病歷與醫學證據審議損害與接種的關聯性，並決定救濟項目與金額；必要時得請專家鑑定或補件。

steps.title: 通知結果與給付
steps.text: 審議結果由疾管署函復申請人；核定給付者由預防接種受害救濟基金撥付。對結果不服可依法提起訴願或行政訴訟。

fee: 免費（審議所需鑑定費用由基金負擔）
legalBasis: 傳染病防治法第 30 條
預防接種受害救濟基金徵收及審議辦法

forms.label: 預防接種受害救濟申請書
歷次審議結果（公開摘要）

contact: 疾病管制署急性傳染病組（總機 02-2395-9825）；申請請洽接種所在地的縣市衛生局；一般諮詢請撥防疫專線 1922

faq.a: 可以。救濟對象是接種國內領有許可證或經專案核准的疫苗，不分公費或自費；但在國外接種、或使用未經核准的疫苗，不在救濟範圍。

faq.q: 要證明接種單位有錯嗎？
faq.a: 不用。受害救濟是無過失制度，審議的是損害與接種之間的關聯性，不是誰有過失。
依案件複雜度與補件情形不同，審議小組按季或視案量開會；本頁列的天數為示意，正式期程請以衛生局與疾管署通知為準。

faq.q: 通報了不良事件，就等於申請救濟了嗎？
faq.a: 不是。醫療院所通報疑似不良事件是監測制度；救濟要由本人或法定代理人另外向衛生局提出申請。

faq.q: 救濟金最多可以領多少？
faq.a: 預防接種受害救濟的死亡給付或極重度障礙給付，確定與接種相關者最高新臺幣 600 萬元，無法確定關聯者最高新臺幣 350 萬元。預防接種受害救濟的嚴重疾病給付，確定相關者最高新臺幣 300 萬元，無法確定關聯者最高新臺幣 120 萬元。重度、中度、輕度障礙與其他不良反應的上限見本頁「救濟給付與金額上限」表；實際金額由審議小組依個案審定（金額待承辦人與現行附表核對）。

en.title: Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP) application
en.summary: If a vaccine recipient suffers harm from a suspected adverse reaction, they or their legal representative can apply for compensation through the local health bureau; an expert review committee decides on causation and payment.
whoCanApply: A person who suspects they were harmed after vaccination
Legal representatives (for minors or persons without legal capacity)
Legal heirs, if the injured person has died
en.introMarkdown:
Under Article 30 of the Communicable Disease Control Act and the Regulations on the Levy and Review of the Vaccine Injury Compensation Fund, people harmed by a vaccine (publicly funded or self-paid, provided it is **licensed in Taiwan or approved under a special case**) may apply for relief. Relief is not damages and does not depend on proving fault by the vaccination site; the review committee decides, on medical grounds, **whether the harm is related to the vaccination**.

**Note the deadlines**: apply **within 2 years** of learning of the harm; no application can be made more than **5 years** after the harm occurred (the current text of the regulations prevails). Common, mild and expected reactions (for example redness or swelling at the injection site, or a brief fever) are outside the scope of relief.

If you feel unwell after vaccination, see a doctor first and keep your medical records. Vaccination sites and medical institutions also report suspected adverse events as required. Applying for relief and reporting are two different things; a report is not an application.

## Benefits and maximum amounts

The review committee decides the amount within the ranges below according to the degree of relationship with the vaccination and the severity of the injury; the table shows **maximums**, and the actual amount depends on the course of treatment and severity in each case.

| Type of benefit | Confirmed as related to vaccination | Relationship cannot be determined |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Death benefit | Up to NT$6 million | Up to NT$3.5 million |
| Disability benefit: profound | Up to NT$6 million | Up to NT$3.5 million |
| Disability benefit: severe | Up to NT$5 million | Up to NT$3 million |
| Disability benefit: moderate | Up to NT$4 million | Up to NT$2.5 million |
| Disability benefit: mild | Up to NT$2.5 million | Up to NT$2 million |
| Serious illness benefit | Up to NT$3 million | Up to NT$1.2 million |
| Other adverse reaction benefit | Up to NT$200,000 | Determined according to the schedule |

Fixed-amount benefits also apply:

- **Funeral subsidy**: NT$300,000 where death is suspected to be due to vaccination and a pathological autopsy has been performed.
- **Stillbirth or miscarriage**: NT$100,000 for a gestation of 20 weeks or more, NT$50,000 for less than 20 weeks.
- **Overlapping benefits**: where a case qualifies for two or more benefits, the higher amount is paid; if a lower amount has already been paid, the difference is made up.

Disability grades are determined under the laws on the rights of persons with disabilities; serious illnesses are determined by the scope of catastrophic illnesses under National Health Insurance or the rules on reporting serious adverse drug reactions.

> This table is compiled from public explanations by the Ministry of Health and Welfare in 2021 and **has not yet been checked word for word against the current schedule of the regulations**; before applying, rely on the current schedule published by the health bureau and Taiwan CDC.
requiredDocuments: Application form for vaccine injury compensation (obtain or download from the health bureau)
Medical record summary, diagnosis certificate or other medical records of the injured person (including dates of visits, diagnosis and treatment)
Vaccination record (child health handbook, vaccination certificate or a certificate from the vaccination site)
ID documents of the injured person and the applicant; legal representatives or heirs must add proof of relationship
In case of death: death certificate and autopsy or expert report (if any)

steps.title: See a doctor first and keep the evidence
steps.text: If a suspected adverse reaction occurs after vaccination, see a doctor first and ask them to record it in detail; keep the vaccination record and all medical receipts.

steps.title: Apply to the health bureau where the vaccination took place
steps.text: Fill in the application form and attach the required documents; submit to the county or city health bureau where the vaccination took place. The bureau will help complete the file and retrieve vaccination and medical records.
steps.who: Applicant, county or city health bureau

steps.title: Preliminary review by the health bureau and referral to Taiwan CDC
steps.text: The health bureau checks that the documents are complete, collects the relevant medical records and sends the file to Taiwan CDC for review.

steps.title: Review by the committee
steps.text: The Vaccine Injury Compensation Review Committee (medical, legal and public-interest members) reviews the harm and its relationship to the vaccination on the basis of medical records and evidence, and decides the benefit and amount; it may request expert opinions or additional documents.

steps.title: Notification and payment
steps.text: Taiwan CDC replies to the applicant in writing; approved benefits are paid from the Vaccine Injury Compensation Fund. An applicant who disagrees with the result may file an administrative appeal or lawsuit as provided by law.

en.fee: Free (expert assessment costs required for the review are borne by the Fund)
en.contact: Taiwan CDC Division of Acute Infectious Diseases (switchboard +886-2-2395-9825); to apply, contact the county or city health bureau where the vaccination took place; for general enquiries call the 1922 hotline.
legalBasis: Regulations on the Levy and Review of the Vaccine Injury Compensation Fund

forms.label: Application form for vaccine injury compensation

faq.q: Can I apply for a self-paid vaccine?
faq.a: Yes. Relief covers vaccines licensed in Taiwan or approved under a special case, whether publicly funded or self-paid; vaccinations received abroad, or with unapproved vaccines, are outside the scope of relief.

faq.q: Do I have to prove that the vaccination site was at fault?
faq.a: No. Vaccine injury compensation is a no-fault system; the committee reviews the relationship between the harm and the vaccination, not who is at fault.

faq.q: How long until there is a result?
faq.a: It depends on the complexity of the case and any requests for additional documents; the committee meets quarterly or according to the caseload. The number of days listed on this page is illustrative; for the official timeline, rely on notices from the health bureau and Taiwan CDC.

faq.q: Does reporting an adverse event count as applying for relief?
faq.a: No. Reporting of suspected adverse events by medical institutions is a surveillance system; relief must be applied for separately by the person concerned or their legal representative through the health bureau.

For death benefits or profound disability benefits under the vaccine injury compensation program, the maximum is NT$6 million where the relationship with vaccination is confirmed and NT$3.5 million where it cannot be determined. For serious illness benefits, the maximum is NT$3 million where the relationship is confirmed and NT$1.2 million where it cannot be determined. Maximums for severe, moderate and mild disability and for other adverse reactions are in the table "Benefits and maximum amounts" on this page; the actual amount is decided by the review committee case by case (amounts are yet to be checked by the responsible officer against the current schedule).

tl.title: Aplikasyon para sa Vaccine Injury Compensation Program (VICP)
tl.summary: Kung ang nabakunahan ay nagkaroon ng pinsala dahil sa pinaghihinalaang masamang reaksyon, siya o ang kanyang legal na kinatawan ay maaaring mag-apply ng kompensasyon sa pamamagitan ng lokal na kawanihan ng kalusugan; ang lupon ng mga eksperto ang magpapasya sa ugnayan ng pinsala at pagbabakuna at sa halaga ng bayad.

vi.title: Đơn xin bồi thường tổn hại do tiêm chủng (VICP)
vi.summary: Người tiêm vắc-xin bị tổn hại nghi do phản ứng bất lợi, hoặc người đại diện hợp pháp, có thể nộp đơn xin bồi thường qua cục y tế địa phương; hội đồng chuyên gia xem xét mối liên quan nhân quả và quyết định việc chi trả.

id.title: Permohonan Program Kompensasi Cedera Vaksin (VICP)
id.summary: Jika penerima vaksin mengalami cedera akibat dugaan reaksi merugikan, ia atau wakil hukumnya dapat mengajukan kompensasi melalui dinas kesehatan setempat; komite pakar menilai hubungan sebab akibat dan menentukan pembayaran.

th.title: การยื่นขอรับการเยียวยาความเสียหายจากการฉีดวัคซีน (VICP)
th.summary: หากผู้ได้รับวัคซีนได้รับความเสียหายจากอาการไม่พึงประสงค์ที่สงสัยว่าเกี่ยวข้อง ตนเองหรือผู้แทนโดยชอบด้วยกฎหมายยื่นขอรับการเยียวยาผ่านสำนักงานสาธารณสุขท้องถิ่นได้ คณะกรรมการผู้เชี่ยวชาญจะพิจารณาความเกี่ยวข้องและกำหนดการจ่ายเงิน
